We need to pick a reference that contains a superset of the labels that we expect to be present in our test dataset. We would also prefer a reference that is generated from a similar technology or protocol as our test dataset.

The version of SingleR in this repository will not be maintained further. Recent advances in single cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) have enabled an unprecedented level of granularity in characterizing gene expression changes in disease models. Multiple single cell analysis methodologies have been developed to detect gene expression changes and to cluster cells by similarity of gene expression. However, the classification of clusters by cell type relies heavily on known marker genes, and the annotation of clusters is performed manually. This strategy suffers from subjectivity and limits adequate differentiation of closely related cell subsets.
